description_en: Retrieves a list of organizations for the current user
description_zh: 查询当前用户的企业列表
name: ListOrganizations

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required when authenticating with an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS)
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en:
Returns only organizations where the user has the specified access level.

5: external member

15: member

60: administrator

70: owner
parameters.help_zh:
用户权限，用于查询指定权限的企业列表
5：企业外部成员
15：企业成员
60：企业管理员
70：企业拥有者
parameters.name: access_level

parameters.help_en:
Returns only organizations where the user's access level is greater than or equal to the specified value.

5: external member

15: member

60: administrator

70: owner

If specified, `minAccessLevel` takes precedence over `accessLevel`
parameters.help_zh:
最小用户权限，用于查询用户权限大于等于该字段设置的企业列表
5：企业外部成员
15：企业成员
60：企业管理员
70：企业拥有者

`minAccessLevel优先生效，不传minAccessLevel时accessLevel参数生效`
parameters.name: min_access_level

items.description_en: An object containing the details of a single organization

accessLevel.description_en:
The user's access level in the organization.

5: external member

15: member

60: administrator

70: owner
accessLevel.description_zh:
用户在企业中的权限
5：企业外部成员
15：企业成员
60：企业管理员
70：企业拥有者

id.description_en:
The primary key ID of the organization.

This is an internal ID that is null if the organization has not enabled Alibaba Cloud Codeup
id.description_zh:
企业主键ID


无业务实际意义，且在企业未开通Codeup时，该值为空

organizationAlias.description_en:
The organization alias.

This field is populated for organizations that have enabled Alibaba Cloud Codeup; otherwise, it is null or empty
organizationAlias.description_zh:
企业别名

若企业开通了Codeup，那么企业别名一般有值；若没有开通，则为空

organizationId.description_en: The unique identifier for the organization, found in the URL on Alibaba Cloud DevOps: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[organizationId]
organizationId.description_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

organizationRole.description_en:
The user's role in the organization.

ORG_EXTERNAL_MEMBER: external member

ORG_MEMBER: member

ORG_ADMIN: administrator

ORG_OWNER: owner
organizationRole.description_zh:
用户在企业中的角色

ORG_EXTERNAL_MEMBER：企业外部成员

ORG_MEMBER：企业成员

ORG_ADMIN：企业管理员
ORG_OWNER：企业拥有者

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
